run_pklToJson: run pklToJson to convert a directory of EFT pickle fitting files into a single JSON output file
build_pklToJson: build a pipeline that converts EFT pickle files to JSON with 2D reprojection error and shape beta filtering
test_pklToJson: test pklToJson by pointing it at a directory of pickle files and verifying the JSON output structure
refactor_pklToJson: refactor pklToJson to accept configurable thresholds for loss_keypoints_2d and maxBeta rejection criteria
review_pklToJson: review pklToJson to understand how it extracts pose, shape, camera, bbox, and keypoint data from pickle files
